name: Ghana

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of red, gold and green, with a black five-pointed star in the centre of the gold stripe.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the blood shed for independence, gold the country's mineral wealth and green its forests; the black star is the lodestar of African freedom.

hook: Ghana's Black Star sits on the gold stripe, the same Black Star that names its football team; Bolivia's red-yellow-green has no star.
trivia: The flag was designed by Theodosia Okoh; from 1964 to 1966 the middle stripe was white, then gold returned.
Ghana's national football team is nicknamed the Black Stars after the flag.
Lake Volta in Ghana is the world's largest artificial reservoir by surface area.
